Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 092. 翻转字符

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    int minFlipsMonoIncr(string s) {
        int n = s.size();
        int left0 = 0, right0 = 0;
        for (char& c : s) {
            right0 += c == '0';
        }
        int ans = min(right0, n - right0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            int x = s[i - 1] == '1';
            right0 -= x ^ 1;
            left0 += x ^ 1;
            ans = min(ans, i - left0 + right0);
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
